Echeveria carnicolor E.Morren, 1874
银明色，由E. Morren发表于1874年Synonym : Cotyledon carnicolor, Baker (1870)
异名：Cotyledon carnicolor, Baker (1870)Series Racemosae
总状花序系
Distribution : Mexico (Veracruz)
分布于墨西哥的Veracruz州
Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :
描述（根据2003IHSP）：Stem usually < 6 cm long, 1 – 1,5 cm in diameter, branching.
茎：长度通常小于6cm，1-1.5cm直径，分枝。Rosette 7 – 10 cm in diameter.
莲座：7-10cm直径Leaves oblong-oblanceolate, obtuse to subacute, 4 – 7 x 1 – 1,5 cm, 5 – 6 mm thick, densely papillose and glistening, greyish or purplish-green.
叶：椭圆形-倒披针形，叶尖圆润或微尖，4-7cm长，1-1.5cm宽，5-6mm厚；上有密集的乳突，闪亮；灰绿色或紫绿色。Inflorescences to 15 cm, equilaterally racemose, often basally branching, bracts easily detached and rooting, pedicels to 8 mm.
花序：可达15cm，等边圆锥花序，常从基部分枝；苞叶很容易脱落并发根；花梗8mm。Flowers : Sepals widely spreading, to 6 mm, corolla sharply pentagonal, to 10 x 6 mm in diameter, salmon-orange above, flesh-colored below.
花：花萼6mm，显著张开；花冠为标准的五边形，可达10mm高、6mm直径，上部为三文鱼肉一样的橙色，下部鲜肉的颜色。Cytology : n = 18
染色体：n=18
Distinctive because of its slightly glistening papillose leaves and short inflorescence.
因为其闪亮的带乳突的叶子而独一无二，短短的花序也很特别。Note:
请注意：According to David Jimeno, plants in the wild are never greyish or bluish-grey like the plants in our collections.
根据David Jimeno的说法，野生环境下的银明色并不像人工养殖的植株那样呈现灰色调或蓝灰色。
